basic_details.job_title: COEP Tech Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: COEP Technological University Pune (COEP Tech), a Unitary Public University of Government of Maharashtra, has invited applications for 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post (Post Code 01/JRF-2) under the ANRF-PAIR project "Development of a Switched Reluctance Motor and Permanent Magnet Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Motor for Electric Tractor". The post pays ₹37,000 plus 30% HRA in years 1 and 2, needs B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with first class, and applications go by Registered Post, Speed Post or Courier to the Registrar, reaching by the 20th of the month, 5:00 pm.

important_dates.application must reach the registrar: By 20th of the month, 5:00 pm (rolling advertisement)

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from the COEP Technological University website, www.coeptech.ac.in, under the "Careers" tab.
Attach photocopies of the relevant testimonials. Applications without required testimonials or with incomplete information are liable to be rejected.

Put the application in an envelope superscribed "APPLICATION FOR RESEARCH POSITION (POST CODE: ) UNDER ANRF-PAIR Programme", with the post code filled in. The notice's example reads "APPLICATION FOR RESEARCH POSITION (POST CODE:01/RA-1) UNDER ANRF-PAIR Programme".
Address it to: The Registrar, COEP Technological University, Wellesley Road, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411 005, Maharashtra, INDIA.
Send it by Registered Post, Speed Post or Courier so that it reaches by the 20th of the month, 5:00 pm.
When applying for more than one post, send a separate application for each post.
For queries about the recruitment, the notice gives the email [email protected]. The University telephone number printed on the letterhead is 020-25507000/09.
important_instructions: The University reserves the right to modify, restrict, or cancel the recruitment process, any application, or any post without assigning any reason. The appointment order is issued only after due vetting and approval by the competent legal authority of the University. Selected candidates must submit an affidavit at the time of joining, affirming acceptance of all terms and conditions of the project appointment. The notice says the form "must reach" by the 20th of the month till 5:00 pm. Documents named in the notice: the application in the prescribed format and photocopies of relevant testimonials.

Offline, by Registered Post / Speed Post / Courier
Rolling advertisement; form must reach by 20th of the month, 5:00 pm

content_sections.heading: About COEP Tech
content_sections.text: COEP Technological University Pune is at Wellesley Road, Shivajinagar, Pune, Maharashtra. The notice describes it as a Unitary Public University of Government of Maharashtra, formerly College of Engineering Pune. It was given the status of "Unitary Technological Public University" in June 2022. The project post is a temporary Project Position under the ANRF-PAIR Hub-Spoke model in collaboration with IIT Bombay.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for Post Code 01/JRF-2 is B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with first class. A valid GATE score is marked "prefer" in the notice. The post row also lists a strong understanding of Engineering Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Thermal Engineering & Heat Transfer, and Vibrations and Structural Dynamics. The notice lists mechanical-domain experience aligned with electrical motor R&D, under three heads: Simulation & Analysis: hands-on experience with FEA tools (ANSYS, COMSOL, HyperMesh, MotorSolve, Flux, Maxwell) for structural analysis of motor components (stress, fatigue, modal, harmonic) Thermal modelling of motors (winding temperature, cooling design, thermal–structural coupling) Vibration and noise analysis (NVH studies for rotating machines) Motor Design & System Knowledge Software Skills Candidates who do not meet the mandatory qualifications may be considered for an appropriate lower designation. In that case, the designation and emoluments follow the prevailing institutional and funding agency guidelines. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments are given "as per ANRF norms". The notice prints ₹ 37,000/- + 30% HRA for Year 1 and 2, and ₹ 42,000/- + 30% HRA for Year 3, 4 and 5. The appointment is initially for 1 year and is extendable up to 4 years subject to satisfactory performance and fund availability. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the ANRF-PAIR Project (2025–2030), or until completion of the project, or as per availability of funds. It does not confer any right to regular or permanent employment at the University. The post is to be treated as non-vacational, as applicable, under the norms of the University and ANRF.

content_sections.heading: COEP Tech Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The JRF will support the design, analysis, prototyping, and validation of SRM and PMaSynRM motors for electric tractor applications. The responsibilities listed are: Mechanical Design & Modelling Structural, Thermal & Vibration Analysis Collaboration with Electrical Design Team Prototype Development Motor Design & Characterization Documentation with research paper publication in well reputed journals

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for COEP Tech Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the COEP Technological University website, www.coeptech.ac.in , under the "Careers" tab. Attach photocopies of the relevant testimonials. Applications without required testimonials or with incomplete information are liable to be rejected. Put the application in an envelope superscribed "APPLICATION FOR RESEARCH POSITION (POST CODE: ) UNDER ANRF-PAIR Programme", with the post code filled in. The notice's example reads "APPLICATION FOR RESEARCH POSITION (POST CODE:01/RA-1) UNDER ANRF-PAIR Programme". Address it to: The Registrar, COEP Technological University, Wellesley Road, Shivajinagar, Pune – 411 005, Maharashtra, INDIA. Send it by Registered Post, Speed Post or Courier so that it reaches by the 20th of the month, 5:00 pm. When applying for more than one post, send a separate application for each post. For queries about the recruitment, the notice gives the email [email protected] . The University telephone number printed on the letterhead is 020-25507000/09.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says applications are processed periodically by the 20th of every month. Shortlisted candidates are notified through their registered email ID. The final list of candidates called for interview is also displayed on the University website. No Travelling Allowance (TA) or Dearness Allowance (DA) is paid for attending the interview. The interview date and the basis of shortlisting are not specified in the notice.
